name: Fierce Cologne
description: Lemon, orange and fir balsam feel crisp and resinous. Jasmine, rosemary and lily of the valley follow, settling into oakmoss, musk and vetiver.

name: Arancia di Capri
description: Mandarin, orange and lemon open juicy and bright, with petitgrain and cardamom adding a green, spicy lift. Musk and caramel give the base a soft, faintly sweet finish.

name: Arancia Di Capri La Riserva
description: A bright Mediterranean citrus: blood orange and mandarin open over rosemary, basil and a salty mineral touch, then dry down to cedar and soft suede.

name: Blu Mediterraneo Arancia di Capri
description: Orange, mandarin and lemon give a sunny, sparkling opening, with petitgrain and cardamom adding a touch of green spice. Caramel and musk close it soft, sweet and clean.

name: Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria
description: Calabrian bergamot and citron shine over cedarwood and red ginger, then ease into a quiet finish of vetiver, benzoin and musk.
description_ru: Калабрийский бергамот и цитрон раскрываются на фоне кедра и красного имбиря, переходя в спокойную базу ветивера, бензоина и мускуса.

image.alt: Флакон Acqua di Parma Bergamotto di Calabria
image.author: Acqua di Parma

reviews.text: В описании своего видео автор связывает аромат с цитрусами, мохито и летним пляжем. Это аннотация описания; видео не расшифровано.
reviews.author: Joy Amin

name: Buongiorno
description: A bright herbal wake-up: lemon, spearmint and rosemary give way to lavandin and petitgrain before a clean base of cedar, amber and musk.

name: Buongiorno Al Bacio
description: Light and kind to the skin: bergamot and rosemary lead into orange blossom and neroli, resting on musk and pale woods.

name: Buongiorno Amore Mio
description: A soft, laundered cloud: sparkling bergamot and aldehydes over cotton, iris and a hedione glow, closing on musks and an ambroxan trail.

name: Buongiorno Buonanotte
description: A calm, powdery evening wood: bergamot and pink pepper melt into iris and guaiac, then settle on cedar, musk and cashmere wood.

name: Buongiorno Dolce Far Niente
description: Lemony and unhurried: citrus peels brighten a heart of lemon and fig wood, ending on cedar, musk and sticky labdanum.

name: Buongiorno Gioco Del Destino
description: Golden and playful: mandarins and orange open onto wheat, ginger and benzoin, ending in a smooth base of musk, sandalwood and balsam.

name: Colonia
description: The classic cologne shape: lemon, orange and bergamot over lavender, rosemary and verbena, with a little rose. Vetiver, sandalwood and patchouli add a dry, earthy base that keeps it crisp.

name: Colonia Essenza
description: A burst of mixed citrus and neroli gives way to rosemary, rose and jasmine accords, finishing on vetiver, patchouli, white musk and amber.
description_ru: Яркое сочетание цитрусов и нероли сменяется розмарином, розой и жасмином. В базе — ветивер, пачули, белый мускус и амбра.

image.alt: Флакон Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza
image.author: Marin Kristic · Scent Grail

reviews.text: Marin Kristic хвалит цитрусовое начало с нероли; на своей коже отмечает 6–8 часов стойкости и умеренный шлейф.
reviews.author: Marin Kristic · Scent Grail

name: Colonia Il Profumo
description: The classic cologne gently deepened: bergamot, grapefruit and blood orange over rosemary and ylang-ylang, anchored by vetiver and patchouli.

name: Colonia Intensa
description: Cardamom and ginger spark through Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian lemon, then myrtle and artemisia lead to leather, cedar wood and benzoin.
description_ru: Кардамон и имбирь придают остроту калабрийскому бергамоту и сицилийскому лимону. Мирт и полынь переходят в базу кожи, кедра и бензоина.

image.alt: Флакон Acqua di Parma Colonia Intensa
image.author: Acqua di Parma

reviews.text: Marin Kristic отмечает лёгкое цитрусовое начало, усиливающуюся древесность и мягкую кожу; особенно рекомендует аромат для тёплых вечеров.
reviews.author: Marin Kristic · Scent Grail
reviews.source_title: Авторский обзор · краткий пересказ раздела Colonia Intensa

name: Colonia Pura
description: Bergamot, orange and petitgrain feel clean and sunny, with coriander and jasmine sambac in the middle and cedarwood and musk below.

name: Crystal Incense
description: Spicy and shimmering: grapefruit, black pepper and ginger lift cardamom, settling on patchouli, benzoin and musk.

name: Fico di Amalfi
description: Lemon, bergamot and grapefruit sit over green fig, pink pepper and jasmine, drying into fig wood, cedarwood and benzoin.

name: Gelsomino A Freddo
description: Jasmine served cold: lemon, pink pepper and artemisia frame jasmine, tea and iris, with guaiac, patchouli and cypriol underneath.

name: Gelsomino A Freddo Ambrosia
description: A richer take on chilled jasmine: cardamom, lemon and frankincense over jasmine, tea, iris and myrrh, finishing on sandalwood, vetiver and cedar.

name: Mandarino Di Sicilia
description: Sweet-sharp citrus grove: mandarin, bergamot, lemon and blood orange over petitgrain and spearmint, finishing soft on patchouli, cedar and musk.

name: Mandorlo di Sicilia
description: Almond sits at the centre, soft and slightly sweet, with ylang-ylang adding a floral glow. Bergamot, anise and orange lift the start, while vanilla, balsam and musk make the base creamy.

name: Mirto Di Panarea La Riserva
description: A Mediterranean herb garden: cedrat, sage and juniper lead to myrtle, lavender and myrrh, finishing on patchouli, labdanum and mastic.

name: Note Di Colonia I
description: An airy cologne with a floral turn: bergamot and neroli meet lavender, rose and a violet accord over patchouli and cedar.

name: Note Di Colonia Ii
description: Citrus-forward and cleanly woody: bergamot, orange and grapefruit with cardamom and basil, then sandalwood, guaiac, musk and vetiver.

name: Note Di Colonia Iii
description: A warmer cologne: mandarin and ginger open onto vetiver, frankincense and jasmine, finishing with tonka bean, myrrh and cistus.

name: Note Di Colonia Iv
description: Citrus and rose with a resinous glow: bergamot and green mandarin, Turkish rose and orange flower, then opoponax, labdanum and patchouli.

name: Note Di Colonia V
description: Crisp and dry: Calabrian lemon, bergamot and pink pepper warmed by ginger and juniper, over sandalwood and cedar.

name: Quercia
description: A citrus-to-forest walk: lemon, bergamot and petitgrain, then cardamom, geranium and cedar, ending on tonka bean, patchouli and oakmoss.

name: Sandalo
description: Fresh citrus meets creamy wood: bergamot, lemon and orange with lavender and cardamom, resting on sandalwood, amber and tonka bean.

name: Yuzu
description: Sparkling yuzu with a light floral heart of lotus, mimosa and jasmine, finishing on soft musk, liquorice and sandalwood.

name: Zafferano
description: Sunny spice and flowers: mandarin, bergamot and coriander over jasmine sambac, saffron and rose, finishing on vanilla, tonka bean and patchouli.

name: Zafferano Ambrosia
description: Saffron-led and golden: mandarin, bergamot and ginger over saffron, orange flower and jasmine, then vanilla, patchouli and an amber accord.

name: 9 AM
description: Mandarin, cardamom and pink pepper open bright and spiced, lavender, orange blossom, rose and apple bloom in the heart, and cedarwood, oakmoss, patchouli and musk settle in.

name: 9 AM Dive
description: Lemon, pink pepper, mint and blackcurrant open cool and juicy, apple, incense and cedarwood take the heart, and patchouli, jasmine, ginger and sandalwood close woody and warm.

name: 9 PM
description: A bright, spiced opening of apple, cinnamon, lavender and bergamot gives way to orange blossom and lily of the valley, before tonka bean, vanilla, amber and patchouli close sweet and warm.

name: 9 PM Rebel
description: Sweet and woody, with mandarin and apple on top, cedarwood and vanilla in the middle, and a warm caramel and musk base.

name: 9 PM Night Out
description: A sweet, warm evening scent: dragon fruit, bergamot and cognac up front, cardamom, suede and toffee in the middle, then tonka, patchouli and woody-amber materials at the finish.

name: 9 PM Elixir
description: Nutmeg and cardamom warm the opening before lavandin and leather take over, closing in a resinous, softly sweet base of labdanum, patchouli and vanilla.
description_ru: Мускатный орех и кардамон согревают начало, затем раскрываются лавандин и кожа. В финале — смолистая, мягко-сладкая база лабданума, пачули и ванили.

reviews.text: Авторский видеообзор 9PM Elixir. Содержание видео ещё не расшифровано; оценка и краткий отзыв не извлечены.
reviews.author: Chad Secrets
reviews.source_title: Ссылка на видеообзор · без текстового резюме

name: Adwaa Al Sharq
description: Saffron, jasmine and caramel begin warm and sweet, amberwood, ambergris and musk give the heart a clean glow, and fir balsam, cedarwood and musk close soft and resinous.

name: Delicious Bouquet
description: Lemon, vanilla and bergamot begin sweet and bright, orange blossom, honey, rum and sugar make a rich heart, and tonka bean, musk, caramel and vanilla close warm.

name: Ebdaa Concentrated Perfume Oil
description: Mandarin and bergamot sparkle, blackcurrant, raspberry and amber make a fruity heart, and cedarwood, vanilla and powdery notes leave a soft base.

name: Edict Amberythme
description: Cinnamon and tonka bean warm amber from the top, saffron, jasmine and vanilla fill the heart, and sandalwood, cedarwood and ambergris leave a sweet, woody base.

name: Edict Musctique
description: Cardamom and musk open with soft, spiced warmth; a heart of vanilla with lily of the valley follows, and oud, mint and musk close with a cool, resinous edge.

name: Historic Olmeda
description: Grapefruit, juniper, cardamom and pink pepper open sharp and bright, jasmine, nutmeg, cedarwood and bergamot form the heart, and musk, ambergris, apple and patchouli close warm.

name: Historic Sahara
description: Bergamot, cinnamon and cardamom open warm and bright, elemi, vanilla and sugar sweeten the heart, and musk, almond, tonka bean, praline and ambroxan leave a creamy base.

name: Inara White
description: Fruit and jasmine start sweet, cedarwood and vanilla warm the heart, and woody notes with amber close dry and soft.

name: Kiaana Crush
description: Saffron opens the way for passion fruit, patchouli and oud, then incense, cedarwood, musk, ambroxan and vanilla leave a resinous, warm base.

name: La Fleur Bouquet
description: Orange blossom, jasmine and peony open soft, lychee, peach and bergamot sweeten the heart, and musk, oakmoss and Petalia close creamy and light.

name: Lynked Forever
description: Mandarin and wild berries start juicy, gardenia, tuberose and ylang-ylang bloom in the heart, and coconut, sandalwood, musk and wood close creamy.

name: Malak
description: Marshmallow, lemon and apple sweeten the opening, musk, coconut and orange blossom make a soft heart, and amber, vanilla and sugar close warm.

name: Mirsaal of Trust
description: Vetiver and Ambrofix open with an earthy lift, saffron and raspberry bring a fruity spice, and amber, carnation and cashmere wood close warm.

name: Modest Deux
description: Raspberry and blackcurrant meet rose, then peony and jasmine add a gentle spice before cedarwood, patchouli and musk settle underneath.

name: Modest Une
description: Bergamot, pepper and lavender open crisp, pink pepper, geranium and elemi warm the heart, and ambroxan, vetiver and patchouli leave an earthy base.

name: Mystique Bouquet
description: Lychee, bergamot, mandarin and peach open bright, peony, mahonia, vetiver and orange blossom bloom in the heart, and oakmoss, vanilla, musk and ambroxan close soft.

name: Ornament pour Femme
description: Passion fruit, coconut, peach and bergamot open tropical, orange blossom and vetiver anchor the heart, and amber, vanilla and musk finish sweet and warm.

name: Ornament pour Homme
description: Apple, lavandin and geranium start green and bright, sandalwood, patchouli and amber warm the heart, and cedarwood, musk and oakmoss finish earthy.

name: Ornament Purple
description: Mandarin, raspberry and grapefruit open juicy, toffee, white flowers, anise and cardamom give a sweet, spiced heart, and musk, vanilla and patchouli close soft.

name: Oud Rising
description: Oud, cypress and orange blossom open dark and green, rosewood, cardamom and amber build a spiced heart, and vetiver, musk and tonka bean leave a warm base.

name: Paris Oud
description: Orange, lemon and blackcurrant start bright, wood, ylang-ylang and amber warm the heart, and powdery notes, musk and tonka bean leave a soft base.

name: Patchouli on Fire
description: Spicy, aromatic and woody notes open, patchouli, lavender and citrus fill the heart, and patchouli with spicy notes closes earthy and dry.

name: Portrait Abstract
description: Vetiver, rhubarb and incense open dry and tart, rose and tonka bean soften the heart, and sandalwood, leather, cedarwood and amber leave a warm, woody base.

name: Portrait Revival
description: Cinnamon, honey, saffron and incense open warm and sweet, tonka bean, oakwood and praline deepen the heart, and dates, sandalwood, caramel and chocolate make a rich base.

name: Rare Carbon
description: A spicy, leathery woody scent for men, with cinnamon and nutmeg over rose, violet and cedar, drying down to vetiver, sandalwood and amber.
description_ru: Пряный кожано-древесный аромат: корица и мускатный орех сочетаются с розой, фиалкой и кедром, а в базе звучат ветивер, сандал и амбра.

name: Rare Passion
description: Orange, musk and rose open soft, amber, wood and vanilla warm the heart, and rose, musk and orange blossom close floral and clean.

name: Rare Reef
description: Blackcurrant, grapefruit and mint sparkle over apricot, basil and rose. Fig and dates add a soft, fruity depth at the base. Fresh, herbal and bright.

name: Souvenir Blooming Bliss
description: Vanilla opens sweet, coconut, palo santo and caramel make a creamy heart, and musk and sandalwood close soft and warm.

name: Souvenir Desert Rose
description: Blackcurrant, raspberry and peach open fruity, musk with heliotrope and lily of the valley makes a powdery heart, and amber, citrus and sandalwood close soft.

name: Souvenir Floral Bouquet
description: Lychee, rhubarb and bergamot open fresh and fruity, rose, lily of the valley, peony and vanilla form a floral heart, and musk, cashmere wood and amber close soft.

name: Supremacy Collectors Edition
description: Pineapple, bergamot and apple open fruity, orange blossom, birch and amber warm the heart, and oakmoss, musk and ambergris leave an earthy base.

name: Supremacy Collector's Edition
description: Pineapple, apple and bergamot lead fruity, orange blossom and birch sit with amber in the heart, and oakmoss, musk and ambergris close warm and earthy.

name: Supremacy Gala
description: Mandarin, red berries and pear blossom open soft and sweet, honeysuckle, frangipani and gardenia form a creamy heart, and patchouli, praline, caramel, brown sugar and vanilla close rich.

name: Supremacy Gold
description: Ylang-ylang and neroli open creamy, vetiver, musk and vanilla soften the heart, and jasmine, musk and sandalwood close warm.

name: Supremacy in Heaven
description: Bergamot and mandarin brighten the start, tea and blackcurrant form a fresh heart, and musk, sandalwood and wood leave a soft finish.

name: Supremacy Incense
description: Bright bergamot and peppery oregano lead to a resinous amber heart with labdanum and opoponax, then a leather, sandalwood, patchouli and oud finish.
description_ru: Яркий бергамот и перечный орегано сменяются смолистым амбровым сердцем с лабданумом и опопонаксом. В базе — кожа, сандал, пачули и уд.

reviews.text: Авторский видеообзор Supremacy Incense. Содержание видео ещё не расшифровано; оценка и краткий отзыв не извлечены.
reviews.author: Absolute Fragrance · Tinuola Ajayi

name: Supremacy Not Only Intense
description: Fresh fruit over a dark, mossy base: bergamot, apple and blackcurrant lead to lavender and patchouli, closing on saffron, musk and ambergris.
description_ru: Свежие фрукты на тёмной мшистой основе: бергамот, яблоко и чёрная смородина сменяются лавандой и пачули. В финале — шафран, мускус и серая амбра.

image.alt: Флакон Afnan Supremacy Not Only Intense
image.author: Afnan Perfumes

name: Supremacy Pink
description: Pink pepper and violet open with a gentle spice, rose, peony and lily of the valley form a powdery floral heart, and musk and amber close warm.

name: Supremacy Purple
description: Orange, bergamot and peach open fruity and bright, amber and musk warm the heart, and pear, musk and vanilla close soft.

name: Supremacy Silver
description: A fresh, fruity-woody fragrance: apple, bergamot and mossy tones open, pineapple, patchouli and jasmine follow, and musk, ambergris and birch settle underneath.
description_ru: Свежий фруктово-древесный аромат: яблоко, бергамот и мшистые оттенки сменяются ананасом, пачули и жасмином. В базе — мускус, серая амбра и берёза.

name: Tribute Blue
description: Bergamot, pimento and nutmeg open spiced and bright, cashmere wood and amber warm the heart, and vetiver, incense and musk leave a dry, woody base.

name: Turathi Blue
description: Bright bergamot and mandarin warm into amber and woody notes, ending on musk and patchouli with a faint spiced edge.

name: Turathi Electric
description: Bergamot, grapefruit, pear and mandarin spark over apple, cedarwood and orange blossom. Vanilla, amber, musk and ambroxan finish it warm and fresh.

name: Turathi Homme
description: Coriander, violet leaf and bergamot open crisp, then rose and pepper. Vanilla, patchouli and amber add a warm, spiced softness.

name: Turathi Purple
description: Spicy and tropical: cardamom and black pepper open onto pineapple and jasmine, finishing with vanilla, moss and patchouli.

name: Turathi Red
description: Rose, musk and floral notes open soft, wood, rose and jasmine build the heart, and apricot, musk and peony close clean and light.

name: Violet Bouquet
description: Saffron and bergamot sit above a sweet heart of caramel, amber and orange, resting on oakmoss and ambergris.

name: Abia Noir
description: A dark spice and leather blend: cardamom and pink pepper over saffron and violet, resting on patchouli, leather and cashmeran.

name: Alf Laila O Laila
description: A rich, ornate blend: saffron, raspberry and rose over a base of amber, oud and musk.

name: Amber Musc
description: A warm, simple pairing of amber and musk, brightened by a rose opening and rounded off with cedar.

name: Amber Santal
description: A dry woody-resinous scent: cypress, pepper and nutmeg open to sandalwood and incense, then patchouli, amber and cedar.

name: Amber Wood
description: Lavender, cardamom and a crisp apple lead to cedarwood and powdery iris, drying down into warm amber and patchouli.

name: Aurum
description: Fruity-floral and golden: raspberry and citrus open to orange blossom, jasmine and saffron, with a honeyed base of musk, amber, sandalwood and vanilla.

name: Aurum Elixir
description: A fruity-sweet gourmand: bergamot, blackcurrant and strawberry over patchouli and vanilla, with jasmine, cashmere wood and caramel below.

name: Chapter 1 By Maxime Exler
description: A warm woody take with fruit: cardamom and amber open onto cashmere wood, sandalwood and white musks, with fig, cypriol and patchouli underneath.

name: Chapter 4 By Nathalie Lorson
description: Incense and pepper over leather and woods, finishing in a darker, sweeter base of cherry, caramel and davana.

name: Cherry Wood
description: Sweet fruit on a woody frame: raspberry, lychee and cherry over frangipani and frankincense, with leather and cashmere wood below.

name: Dahn Al Oudh Moattaq
description: Turkish rose and oud sit side by side, resinous and warm, with amber and a soft powdery musk drawing the edges together.

name: Evoke
description: A classic floral-chypre feel: bergamot and pink pepper over rose, jasmine and iris, with oakmoss, patchouli and vanilla underneath.

name: Evoke Red Edition Her
description: A sweet, creamy blend: iris, popcorn and pink pepper over magnolia and macadamia, drying down to sandalwood, musk and vanilla.

name: Evoke Red Edition Him
description: Sweet and spicy with an herbal edge: pink pepper, strawberry and cinnamon over sage, caramel and lavender, on benzoin, labdanum and tonka bean.

name: Evoke Silver Edition Her
description: A polished, powdery floral: aldehydes and bergamot lift iris, ylang-ylang and rose, settling on amber, benzoin, musk and vanilla.

name: Kuro
description: Green and aromatic with a deep base: geranium and bergamot, lavender, pepper and elemi, then ambergris, patchouli and vetiver.

name: Neutron
description: Clean and herbal: artemisia, lemon and rosemary over musk, carnation and geranium, ending in oakmoss and cedar.

name: Oud Mist
description: A smooth, warm oud style: cardamom and pepper over osmanthus and leather, finishing on cypriol, amber and cashmere wood.

name: Raindrops
description: A citrus-and-flower blend: bergamot, mandarin and orange over rose, ylang-ylang and jasmine, finishing with musk, amber and styrax.

name: Sacred Love
description: A fruity floral with woody depth: blackcurrant and lily open to peach and jasmine, ending in vetiver, amber and sandalwood.

name: Wisal Dhahab
description: A fruity floral: mandarin, apple and pear open brightly, orchid, jasmine and rose fill the middle, and musk, sandalwood and patchouli leave a soft woody base.

name: Amber Oud Gold Edition
description: Melon and pineapple glow over a sweet gourmand accord, with amber, vanilla and soft musk rounding out the warmth.

name: Detour Noir
description: Sparkling bergamot, mandarin and pepper give way to violet and jasmine, then a creamy, woody base of sandalwood, patchouli and vanilla.

name: Oudh 36
description: Ylang-ylang and rose lie over a dense, resinous base of labdanum, amber and benzoin, with patchouli and cedarwood adding depth.

name: Decision
description: Pink pepper, bergamot and cardamom open bright and spiced. Frankincense, juniper and myrrh give a resinous heart, while patchouli, cedarwood and vanilla end warm and woody.

name: Dia Woman
description: Fig, tarragon and sage start green and fresh, followed by peach blossom, rose and peony, then a soft base of sandalwood, frankincense and vanilla.

name: Epic 56 Woman
description: Cumin, pink pepper and cinnamon open warm and spiced. Rose, geranium and tea shape the heart, and amber, oud, frankincense, sandalwood and vanilla make a rich, woody base.

name: Epic Woman
description: Rose and jasmine sit over spiced cumin and cinnamon, with a touch of tea. Oud, frankincense, sandalwood, patchouli and vanilla give a dense, warm, floral base.

name: Gold Man
description: A classic rose-and-lily opening with jasmine, orris and myrrh in the heart, over an animalic, mossy base of ambergris, civet, sandalwood and patchouli.

name: Guidance
description: Pear, frankincense and hazelnut lead into saffron, rose and osmanthus. Labdanum, sandalwood, ambergris and vanilla make a warm, sweet and woody close.

name: Guidance 46
description: Pear, hazelnut, rose and almond open with a sweet, spiced glow. Saffron and jasmine sambac lead down to sandalwood, labdanum and vanilla, floral and deeply warm.

name: Honour 43 Woman
description: Rhubarb, pepper and coriander open sharp, then jasmine, tuberose, gardenia and carnation fill the heart. Sandalwood, labdanum, leather and frankincense finish creamy and resinous.

name: Honour Man
description: A peppery, aromatic woody scent: two peppers and nutmeg give it bite, geranium and elemi add a green lift, and patchouli, vetiver, cedar and tonka settle it down.

name: Interlude 53 Man
description: Bergamot, oregano and pimento open with a herbal bite. Amber, frankincense and labdanum make a resinous heart, and leather, oud and patchouli leave a smoky, deep base.

name: Interlude Black Iris
description: Violet, rosemary and bergamot open crisp, iris and myrrh form a powdery, resinous heart, and leather, oud, sandalwood and cedarwood give a dry, smoky base.

name: Journey Man
description: A bright citrus-and-spice opening of Sichuan pepper, bergamot and cardamom leads to juniper, frankincense and tobacco, ending in a leathery, sweet-woody base with tonka and cypriol.

name: Jubilation XXV Man
description: A rich, resinous scent with a fruity, spicy start of orange, blackberry and coriander, a honeyed heart with clove and rose, and a deep base of oud, myrrh, moss and ambergris.

name: Lilac Love
description: Lilac, peony and gardenia are soft and powdery, with iris and chocolate in the middle. Vanilla, patchouli and sandalwood bring sweetness and warmth.

name: Lineage
description: Ginger, Sichuan pepper and saffron open sharp and bright. Frankincense, fenugreek and myrrh fill the heart, and vetiver, patchouli, benzoin and labdanum make it earthy and resinous.

name: Love Delight
description: Ginger, mandarin and cinnamon spice up a rose-led opening. Heliotrope and jasmine sweeten the heart, and vanilla, chocolate, rum and cypriol leave a warm, dessert-like base.

name: Love Hibiscus
description: Caramel and passion fruit give a sweet, juicy opening, lifted by bergamot. Hibiscus, iris and frankincense follow, and sandalwood, cypriol and vanilla make it soft and powdery.

name: Lyric Woman
description: A rose-led floral oriental. Warm spices and bergamot open onto a bouquet of rose, jasmine and ylang-ylang, resting on moss, woods, vanilla, tonka and frankincense.

name: Memoir Man
description: A herbal, bitter-green opening of absinth, basil and mint gives way to rose and lavender, then a long, smoky base of leather, tobacco, vetiver, oakmoss and amber.

name: Opus I
description: Cardamom, bitter orange and plum precede a lush bouquet of jasmine, tuberose and rose. Vetiver, sandalwood and frankincense give a deep, creamy woodiness.

name: Opus XV King Blue
description: Mandarin, blackcurrant and pink pepper open lightly. Frankincense and amber bring a resinous heart, and sandalwood, oakwood, patchouli, oud and leather make a deep, woody base.

name: Overture Woman
description: Bergamot, saffron and apple open bright and slightly spiced. Rose, geranium and cinnamon fill the heart, and incense, labdanum and leather leave a warm, resinous trail.

name: Reflection Man
description: An elegant, herbal-floral classic: rosemary and petitgrain open to neroli, iris and jasmine, resting on vetiver, patchouli and sandalwood.

name: Reflection Woman
description: Violet and green leaves open cool, then magnolia, ylang-ylang and jasmine bloom softly over cedarwood, sandalwood and musk.

name: Search
description: Lemon, lime and mandarin give a bright citrus start. Frankincense, pepper and elemi bring a resinous heart, and cade, vetiver and guaiac wood leave a smoky, earthy finish.

name: Eau d'Hadrien
description: A Mediterranean citrus scent: Sicilian lemon, citron, grapefruit and bergamot meet green mandarin and juniper, over cypress and white musk.

name: Nuit Étoilée
description: Lemon, mint and orange are cool and sparkling, with pine and fir balsam at the heart. Tonka bean and immortelle leave a gently sweet trail.

name: Petite Chérie

name: Rose Pompon

name: Un Matin d'Orage
description: A stormy white floral: shiso and ginger start it, tuberose, gardenia and nutmeg bloom in the middle, and guaiac wood, myrrh and vanilla close it.

name: Madawi
description: Pineapple brings a juicy brightness to a creamy orange blossom heart, which settles on earthy patchouli.

name: Ari
description: Pear and raspberry open juicy and light, then lily of the valley, rose and orchid make a soft floral heart. Musk, woody notes and marshmallow leave a sweet, airy finish.

name: Cloud
description: A soft gourmand: lavender, pear and bergamot open lightly, coconut, praline and vanilla orchid make a creamy heart, and a cashmere base keeps it plush.

name: God Is A Woman
description: Pear and ambrette open soft and slightly musky, with iris and Turkish rose forming a powdery heart. Vanilla and sandalwood close it, sweet, warm and gently creamy.

name: Moonlight
description: Blackcurrant and plum brighten a heart of marshmallow and peony. Amber, sandalwood and vanilla keep the drydown soft and warm.

name: R.E.M.

name: Sweet Like Candy

name: Amber Arabia Oud

name: Art D' Amour pour Femme

name: Aura

name: Aura Fresh
description: Lemon, bergamot and cardamom sparkle over pepper and sage, resting on cedarwood, saffron and amber. Fresh, spiced and quietly warm.

name: Beau Acute Men
description: Lemon, orange and petitgrain meet an herbal heart of lavender, sage and rosemary, softened by jasmine and rose, over cedarwood and vetiver. Clean and green.

name: Black Saffron
description: Lavender and ginger lead to a sweet, earthy middle of patchouli, vanilla and tonka bean. Amber, sandalwood and vetiver keep it warm and soft.

name: Blue Homme

name: Blue Sky

name: Bucephalus No. IX

name: Bucephalus No. XII

name: Bucephalus No. Xv
description: Lemon and bergamot lift a powdery heart of rose and violet, with patchouli adding an earthy note. Amber settles underneath, floral and softly dry.

name: Checkmate Queen
description: Tuberose and green leaves meet fig and spice, then dry down to sandalwood and a powdery softness. Fruity, green and floral.

name: Christian Provenzano II
description: Passion fruit and saffron brighten a resinous heart of oud, patchouli and benzoin. Leather and amber close it, earthy and warm.

name: Christian Provenzano III
description: Bergamot, mandarin and neroli sparkle with pink pepper, then apple, rose and cedarwood. The base of musk, vetiver and cinnamon is soft and lightly spiced.

name: Christian Provenzano IV
description: Orange, bergamot and pink pepper brighten creamy tuberose and ylang-ylang. A soft base of musk, vanilla and amber rounds the bloom.

name: Club de Nuit Blue Iconic

image.alt: Флакон Armaf Club de Nuit Milestone
image.author: Armaf

image.author: Armaf

name: Profumi D'art 10 Belin Ché Cana
description: Grapefruit, jasmine and vetiver: a citrusy floral that dries into an earthy, creamy finish.

name: Profumi D'art 12 Per Me Ma
description: Milky and softly sweet, with iris and rose over a base of chocolate, vanilla and tonka bean. Heliotrope gives it a powdery, cushioned feel.

name: Q Essence Woman
description: Pear, patchouli and magnolia make a fruity, earthy floral with a creamy end.

name: Q Uomo Perfume Man
description: Grapefruit opens fresh, amber warms the heart, and ginger spices the base. Citrusy, warm and spiced.

name: Radical Blue Man
description: Melon and verbena open cool and green, then lavender, basil and ginger bring a herbal snap before tonka bean, patchouli and cashmeran warm the finish.

name: Radical Brown Man
description: Lemon and cinnamon sharpen the opening, lavender and incense smoulder through the middle with a thread of tobacco, and cedarwood, labdanum and amber hold the base.

name: Red Velvet
description: Lemon sparkles on top, sugar sweetens the heart, and vanilla makes a warm base. Sweet and bright.

name: Royal Amber Oud pour Homme
description: Berries and rhubarb meet iris and pink pepper at first, with carnation and rose in the heart. Oud, cypriol, vetiver and leather make the base dark and earthy.

name: Sauville pour Homme
description: Mint, lemon and pepper open cold and sharp, sage, pink pepper and lavender sit in the heart, and vetiver, ambroxan, patchouli, cedarwood and labdanum close dry and warm.

name: Seduction pour Homme
description: Grapefruit and sea notes feel crisp and salty, with geranium, bay and spice in the middle. A light base of guaiac wood and amber warms the end.

name: Sehr Aleuyun Sawdaa
description: Cardamom and saffron spice a bergamot opening, rose and oud sit in the heart, and amber, sandalwood and musk finish soft and resinous.

name: Sehr Aleuyun Zarqaa
description: Pear and lemon meet clove and bergamot, then cinnamon and amyris carry the warmth down to patchouli, sandalwood, amber and tonka bean.

name: Seine Amour Belvico
description: Pear and bergamot with a pinch of pink pepper open onto rose, jasmine and iris. Patchouli, vanilla and musk give it a powdery, gentle finish.
